original: A flat crater amidst the hilly landscape of Bavarian Swabia: the Nördlinger Ries is an all-round phenomenon and the result of a violent cosmic encounter: 15 million years ago, a mighty meteorite crashed down from the sky and created a perfectly circular crater in the earth’s crust. Diameter: 25 kilometres!

Durchmesser: 25 Kilometer!
